facts.fact: The Eighth National Development Plan 2022-2026 commits the Government to decentralise the civil and vital registration system, including operationalisation of the Integrated National Registration Information System, and lists civil registration and vital statistics automation as a programme under its health information strategy.

systems.tiers: to be operationalised as the civil and vital registration system is decentralised

note: Passages only; the sentence naming the system is cut off after 'Integrated National Registration'. A plan's intentions only: nothing on events, how the record is made or offices.
